Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset: WizardCard fantasy pixel-art duel interface visual prototype. Produce one landscape image, requested 1600x1000, 16:10. This is a readable desktop Chinese card-game UI, thoughtfully designed and distinctive, all dark slate and aged brass, precise square pixel clusters and stepped shading, strong handcrafted 16-bit/modern pixel fantasy art. Flat front-facing screen, no device, no perspective. Decorations confined to corners, no visually noisy background.

Opponent section y88..386; player section y413..711. Each section has a resource header and FIVE narrow equally sized public zone columns at x26,245,464,683,902, width208 and height222, titled 解析, 咒文, 施法, 行动, 灰烬. Cards in each column are HORIZONTAL 196x52 compact strips, text priority, not vertical collectible cards. Leave some zones empty as continuous dark wells, no fixed-slot grid in casting.
Each player header shows four distinct symbols with readable labels: heart-shaped coral life core 生命 30; cyan faceted crystal 魔素 4; brass burden weight 荷载 2; open teal support arch 容量 5. Actions separate label 已用行动 1/3 with one filled token and two hollow tokens. Opponent hand private, only count 手牌 5.
Own bottom hand panel at x26 y760 width1090 height212, five small horizontal cards roughly143x57, with names 均衡, 火球术, 银光锐语, 奥术圆环, 奥术回想, leaving whitespace. Keep names and small semantic type labels inside them, no full-art miniature portraits.
Right panel includes title 操作面板, selected card 火球术, restrained abstract fireball thumbnail, separated text area, two action choices 开始解析 and 结束回合, clear 确认操作 and 取消 buttons, compact log area. Selected strip uses teal corner brackets, candidate target uses thin brass dotted corners, current target uses a distinct solid coral diamond marker. Example statuses are 解析中, 解析完成, 待施放, 持续生效, with icon plus text. Basic formation has small shield tag 基础; an attached rune uses chain link →宿主. Do not overcrowd.
Art direction: solemn arcane observatory / illuminated grimoire, worn brass octagonal corners, tiny engraved rune chips, dark indigo stone panels, quiet teal rune accents. Strong visual hierarchy and generous content space. No new character powers, shops, booster packs, or decorative huge illustration behind text. No gradients, photorealism, soft bloom, blur, antialiasing, UI glassmorphism, watermark. Pixel craftsmanship must be obvious. Simplify details before sacrificing legibility.

Composition is centered but generous and impressive, teal and brass focal light without glowing fog.
